class.name: QuantumDarwinismCouplingRule
class.brief_description: Defines a cross-channel threshold and permeability coupling rule for Quantum Darwinism.
class.description: When the source channel locks in a slot, shifts the effective einselection threshold (delta_threshold_tau), propagation permeability (delta_permeability_gamma), and optional value/state bias of the target channel across slots matching scope and topology_mask.

members.member: Source channel whose einselection triggers this coupling rule.
Target channel modulated when the source channel locks.
Threshold shift applied to target channel (negative accelerates crystallization, positive inhibits it).
Permeability shift applied to target channel.
CSS-style rule scope (Self:0, Children:1, Descendants:2, Siblings:3, All:4).
